ANSWER 01: T1-T14 as you amended are agreed, with two design fixes before HANDIN (details: evidence/01/qa-w.md ## Agreement). D1: clause 1 (last assistant record stop_reason tool_use) is true for every pane working mid-turn, so sampling before cswitch marks all working panes, against "working ignored"; say when clause 1 is sampled for a working pane (e.g. when cswitch's agent wait returns, before /exit) and add a stub test. D2: "no pane of the workspace still off-default" lets one failed/not-idle pane block all wakes until the 30 min expiry deletes them unsent; give a bound and a test. Carried into 02's AC: real failed-SendMessage and blocked samples via read-only live run (REV-5b), else .derived and marked unverified in HANDOFF; agent wait --until fix gets its own stub test; usage compare on first live batch (T5). Open points 1-2 accepted as stated.

BLOCKED 02: QA-b can't isolate cautoswitch from the live herdr, so I stopped. In /tmp/qab-02 with `env -i HOME=<temp> PATH=<fakebin>:/usr/bin:/bin HERDR_ENV=1 bin/cautoswitch --once --dry-run`, my fake `herdr` on PATH was never called (its log file never appeared), yet output was `ok: w31 -> c1 n/a`. w31 is a live workspace id, so the launcher reached the real herdr (probably an absolute path or the default socket). Only dry-run was run, but nothing non-dry-run is safe here. I need either (a) the supported way to point cautoswitch/cwake at a stub herdr (env var or bin path), told as a user-visible setting, not code, or (b) your ruling that the Dev's stub harness is the accepted blackbox vehicle, with permission to read tests/ca_stubs.py. FAIL 02: sha 0f80fe5, findings F1-F2 in .claude/squads/accounts/scopes/autoswitch/evidence/02/qa-w.md. Tests: 154 OK on a clean clone. F1 (blocker): cwake clause2 needs tool_result is_error:true, but real failed SendMessage results have no is_error; they carry toolUseResult.success=false on the user record (+ content text JSON {"success":false,"message":"No agent named ... is reachable"}). Real sample: ~/.claude-2/projects/*/be3e1bf7-9b0e-485c-b78a-3ae359ab3e95.jsonl at 2026-10-16T04:53:41.550Z; 267 such records, 0 with is_error. So the sender is never woken on live data; the .derived fixture encodes the guess. Fix clause2 to use toolUseResult.success is False (or content-JSON success:false), rebuild the fixture from the real shape, add a no-is_error test, drop the UNVERIFIED notes. F2 minor: put the real input keys (to, summary, message) in the fixture. Re-hand in with the new sha; I re-check only these.

FINAL 02: (b). cautoswitch finds panes from live /proc environ, so no env var can isolate it; do NOT run it outside the stub harness again (even dry-run). The Dev's stub harness (tests/ca_stubs.py, in /tmp/qab-02/tests) is the accepted blackbox vehicle; you may read tests/ca_stubs.py and the test files to see which behaviours they exercise. Check the business AC (PO E1) from what the harness runs and logs show: every off-default pane moves silently with no wake prompt; only a pane with pending work gets one short prompt after the batch; idle no-work panes get none; CSWITCH_WAKE=off = old behaviour; a failed read never wakes everyone. Run the tests you need in /tmp/qab-02 (prompts go to the PO, don't relay). A case the harness does not cover = a finding, or "untested live" in your verdict. Send PASS/FAIL to Dev-2 and me.
